environment.description: Same NestJS microservice on ECS Fargate behind AWS ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following configuration: (1) AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5-minute window per source IP on the /api/v2/tokens/* URI path with action BLOCK, (3) a custom regex pattern set rule matching request bodies containing repeated base64-encoded 16-byte blocks (pattern: identical consecutive 24-character base64 segments indicating oracle probing) with action BLOCK and priority 1. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics are enabled with sampled requests. The rate-based rule uses a scope-down statement matching only POST requests to paths beginning with /api/v2/tokens/decrypt and /api/v2/tokens/validate.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association

waf_rules.name: RepeatedBlockPatternDetection
waf_rules.pattern: body matches repeated 24-char base64 segments indicative of CBC oracle byte-walking

config.logging: WAF full logging to S3 with CloudWatch metrics
